verdict.rationale: gstack publishes its own skill listing in docs/skills.md: a table of each skill with its role and description (e.g., /plan-design-review, the design-system builder, the spec writer, debugging). A developer can browse this on GitHub before installing. It is only a static doc listing gstack's own bundled skills, not a searchable registry, leaderboard, or marketplace. The gitagent registry entry was published by a user, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: search or filter capability, a registry or marketplace of installable skills beyond the fixed bundle, per-skill selective install from a catalog, popularity or leaderboard signals, and independent corroboration.
